scope: Default traditional text search/details/TOC/two chapters and next-page content/cache/reopen/progress; existing explore enter/leave/pause wiring only.

findings.title: Disk category cache skips opening the actual original exploration context
evidence: DiscoverViewModel.swift:476-479 applies a disk categories hit and returns before discoverItems.
BookSourceFetcher+Discover.swift:30/34 is the normal openOriginalExploreContext entry.
DiscoverViewModel.swift:329-335 returns without infoMapValues when there are no button/text/toggle controls.
OriginalTraditionalRuntime.kt:153 uses create=false for actual explore book requests; OriginalExploreContexts.kt:45 makes an unopened temporary Entry with map=nil.
DiscoverKindsCache.swift:4/34 stores and reopens nonempty categories on disk; process LRU InfoMap is deliberately not retained across restart.
findings.trigger: Restart with a valid cached categories list and no quick actions, then load a traditional category whose source rules read infoMap. UI can issue the real explore request without first opening/restoring the original map for the same backing/source/revision.
findings.impact: Missing InfoMap/original lifecycle semantics on an actual cache-hit route. This is a source-level reachable discontinuity, not a measured device failure.
findings.minimumFix: Use the same DI fetcher/context-open operation before accepting either cached or network categories; preserve source revision checks and do not add an owner/cache/runtime.

findings.title: Leaving an exploration page while App stays active never saves pending InfoMap
evidence: ExploreSourcePage.swift:75 invokes refreshSources on appear and contains no page-leave/pause hook.
BookSourceFetcher+OriginalPreview.swift:17 exposes savePendingOriginalExploreContext but no product caller invokes it.
yuedu_appApp.swift:341-343 only schedules the all-source sweep when scenePhase != active.
InfoMap.kt:23-26 save() marks needSave; only saveNow persists and clears the flag.
Locked ExploreAdapter.kt:679-688 onPause saves every dirty original map.
findings.trigger: An explore UI expression writes map values and calls infoMap.save(); navigate away while the application remains active.
findings.impact: The map remains pending until an unrelated app inactive/background transition, rather than the actual exploration page pause. A process/context eviction before that later transition has no acknowledged save.
findings.minimumFix: Same DiscoverViewModel/source owner handles enter/leave; cancel and drain page loads, then call existing pending-save operation without deleting failed pending state or constructing another owner; serialize repeat disappear/rapid reentry.

verifiedSourceWiring: Traditional search/details/TOC route through mainJSService originalSearch/originalDetails/originalTOC. mainJs has its existing explicit separate branch; no observed legacy-JSC fallback in these paths.

ChapterFetchManager resolves actual source and store, lends the active book/chapter/generation to fetchOriginalOwnedChapterPackage. That entry uses original singleChapter content, actual nextChapterURL, final variable/body CAS, durable readback and publishVerifiedChapterCache.
WebBook/BookContent own next-page loop, next-chapter stop, original subContent and cancellation; the public Swift reader does not reimplement them.

OnlineBookView adopts preview business values and transfers into a real temporary/shelf BookStore UUID before opening the reader. Existing stored refresh remains in the same BookStore/ChapterStore owners.

Native testNativeOriginalPublicConsumersUseOwnedReaderAndOfflineReopen defines the real search/details/TOC2pages/content2pages/twochapters sequence, closes TCP peer then reopens from disk. These are definitions, not execution results from this review.

ReaderNavigator persists spineIndex/charOffset through the injected ReadingPositionStore, restores through the same owner, and flushes from ReaderView saveProgress at exit/inactive/background. No additional definite progress/cache-success/stale-body publication bug was established in this bounded review.

Existing generation tokens, actual cache identity validators, revocation, final CAS and cancellation reported-effects checks remain present. Discover showcase reload remaps fresh UUIDs and rejects an old section id; no definite same-id stale result publication was established.
rejectedHypotheses: Do not claim failed/empty categories are durably cached: DiscoverKindsCache.store refuses empty arrays and cache load also rejects them.

Do not infer the whole original WebBook is unimplemented from old completion-plan preparatory prose; later core-default-original-consumers-step records and current source have the actual production path.
The cached-open issue is conditional on a cold original process/revision and absent quick actions; controls may incidentally open the map later, which is not the category-cache lifecycle guarantee.

notProven: A real site or user source result

nextAuthorizedSlice: Root authorized ignored .build/original-explore-page-lifecycle-step for the two findings; no layout change and no current f2 job/tag change.
